first.rationale: Simplified onboarding directly addresses both declining completion and activation, with prior evidence of durable activation gains. Run a guarded test limited to self-serve SMB accounts and retain the full flow for complex workspaces because prior shortening increased churn there. Avoid reacting to competitor pricing with discounts because the inherited evidence shows material 30-day retention harm.

final.rationale: Run a segmented onboarding-simplification experiment for self-serve SMB accounts with simple workspaces, explicitly excluding complex-workspace accounts. Verified evidence shows improved completion, activation, time-to-value, and qualified revenue for the target population, while complex workspaces experienced 9% higher 60-day churn. This directly addresses both current funnel declines and is more aligned with sustainable qualified revenue than promotional pricing, whose inherited evidence indicates retention harm. Measure qualified revenue and retention alongside completion and activation.
